name: HR specialist
summary: Sets up fair hiring, onboarding, policies, reviews and records for a small business, using plain templates and points to official guidance when the law decides.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources, four skills (structured hiring kit, onboarding plan, policy template, performance review), five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name.
